title: What’s Behind One Nation’s Attacks on Andrew Hastie?
author: Grant Wyeth
text:
Credit: Facebook / Andrew Hastie
What populist nationalists find most offensive about liberal democracy is the rule of law. The idea that there should be an equal and impartial exercise of laws is an affront to both their belief in social hierarchies, and also their desire to exercise power in an arbitrary manner. To them, the law should be used to advance their concept of the nation, and privilege or discriminate based on who represents or challenges their beliefs. This hostility toward the rule of law intensifies when they find a prominent symbolic vehicle for their political ambitions. This attempt to bend the country to their will is now being demonstrated in Australia through the One Nation party and its relentless attacks on Liberal Party MP Andrew Hastie. The party has commissioned cartoons that refer to Hastie as a “traitor” and a “gutless maggot.”  The social media swamp that One Nation swims in and facilitates has become so aggressive and threatening that Hastie has had to employ security at both his electorate office and his home – something incredibly rare in Australia. [...]
